meta.name: database-documentation
meta.description: Generate grounded-and-verified, engine-agnostic database documentation that reaches 100% parity with the real schema. Introspects the LIVE database as ground truth and cross-validates it against ORM models, migrations, generated types, seeds, and application queries, then proves completeness by diffing the docs back against the database. Produces ER diagrams (mermaid), per-table data dictionaries, and a machine-readable schema.json. Works with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, and SQLite across any ORM (Prisma, TypeORM, Drizzle, Sequelize, Knex, Django, Rails) or raw SQL. Use when asked to document a database, produce an ERD or data dictionary, write db/schema docs, audit schema drift, or refresh existing DB docs.
